The following figures shows the uniform hazard spectra for spectral ordinates with 5% damping in sites with Vs30=1000 m/s presented across various confidence levels.



```{r echo=FALSE}
TR_TARGET <- c(200,500,1000,2000,2500,5000,10000)
Vs30_TARGET <- 1000
YMAX <- 0.35
```


::: {.content-hidden when-format="html"}

```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
#| fig-cap: "Uniform Hazard Spectra Sa[g] with 5% damping (mean) for sites with Vs30=1000 m/s"
#| label: fig-UHS_1000_docx
#| column: body-outset-right
#| 
DATA <- UHSTable[TR %in% TR_TARGET & Vs30 %in% Vs30_TARGET & p %in% p_TARGET,.(ID=TR,Y=Sa,X=Tn)]|> unique()
setorder(DATA,X)
PLOT <- buildPlot(
  library = "hc",
  yAxis.label =TRUE,
  plot.type="line",
  legend.layout="horizontal",
  legend.show=TRUE,
  xAxis.log = FALSE,
  yAxis.log = FALSE,
  xAxis.legend="Tn[s]",
  yAxis.legend="Sa[g]",
  group.legend="TR[yr]",
  data=DATA)
PLOT
```


:::


::: {.panel-tabset .nav-pills .content-visible when-format="html" unless-format="revealjs"}

#### p=mean
```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
#| fig-cap: "Uniform Hazard Spectra Sa[g] with 5% damping (mean) for sites with Vs30=1000 m/s"
#| label: fig-UHS_mean

p_TARGET <- "mean"

DATA <- UHSTable[Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & p %in% p_TARGET,.(ID=TR,Y=Sa,X=Tn)]|> unique()
setorder(DATA,X)
PLOT <- buildPlot(
  library = "hc",
  yAxis.label =TRUE,
  plot.type="line",
  legend.layout="horizontal",
  legend.show=FALSE,
  xAxis.log = FALSE,
  yAxis.log = FALSE,
  yAxis.max = YMAX,
  xAxis.legend="Tn[s]",
  yAxis.legend="Sa[g]",
  group.legend="TR[yr]",
  data=DATA)
PLOT
```
